## Purpose
`/libraries/$id`: one document library. It shows its documents and settings, and supports edit and delete.

## Responsibilities
`LibraryDetailPage`:
- finds the library in `librariesApi.list`;
- `LibraryPanels` holds the documents and uploads;
- `LibraryFormDialog` edits it;
- `librariesApi.remove` deletes it ("Library deleted.").

Titled "Library — Agentic AI Design Patterns".

## Key elements
`LibraryDetailPage`.

## Control flow
React Query.

## Data, state and side effects
Library changes.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Backend:** `/api/libraries`.

## Error handling and edge cases
- Deleting a library attached to an agent is refused by the server's delete rules.

## Nuances and gotchas
There is no single-library GET; the page picks the library out of the list.

As described.
